The '''1992–93 Copa del Rey''' was the 91st staging of the [[Copa del Rey]].

The competition started on 28 August 1992 and concluded on 26 June 1993 with the Final, held at the [[Estadio Luis Casanova]] in [[Valencia, Spain|Valencia]].
